attempts.verdict: refused by the program at the PAUSE gate (Paused, 6005) — register's first check

note: Fired into T3's paused window on pool 29. The pool was Open and Config.paused read TRUE from chain, so the refusal can only be the pause gate — which register checks before the state gate, the deadline and capacity.

uiAttempt.whyThatMatters: UI-B deliberately had no seat when this was fired, so the refusal has exactly one possible cause. A wallet already holding a seat would fail for two reasons at once and demonstrate neither.
uiAttempt.copyShown: Entries are paused right now, so this one was not accepted and nothing settled. Try again a little later.
assessment: A sentence a player can read — not a spinner, not a raw error code.
Names the actual reason: entries are paused.
States the outcome plainly: this entry was not accepted.
Does not imply the pool is finished, or that funds are at risk.
Gives the player a next step rather than leaving them stuck.
Carries no PID §8.7 forbidden vocabulary and no urgency language (D3).
uiAttempt.oneObservationForTheFounder: "nothing settled" is precise but may not be plain: it correctly avoids claiming the player was charged NOTHING, since a refused attempt still costs a network fee (15000 lamports measured on the headless attempt in the same window). Whether a lay player reads "settled" that way is founder-and-counsel territory, not an engineering defect, and it is recorded rather than changed.
uiAttempt.recovers: The criterion T6 surrendered under §F-36 option (a) — a human reading a refusal in words. Not the same refusal path as T6 (pause, not a sealed pool), so it is the same CLASS of evidence rather than the same evidence.
